tests.name: higher temporal resolution ocean forcing
tests.hypothesis: error growth rate decreases with hourly forcing
tests.risk: product change confounds cadence with model version

tests.name: higher spatial resolution ocean forcing
tests.dependentVariable: M3 72 h, bearing difference, highest-error cases

tests.name: surface current product comparison
tests.hypothesis: an independent surface-current reference reduces directional error
tests.risk: geostrophic products omit ageostrophic surface flow

tests.name: depth sensitivity
tests.hypothesis: trajectories forced at 0/5/10/15/20 m differ measurably; 15 m is or is not the closest to observations
tests.risk: multiple comparisons; must be preregistered with a fixed depth set and no post-hoc selection

tests.name: windage-only sensitivity (structural, not alpha search)
tests.hypothesis: windage direction relative to the error vector is unit-dependent
tests.risk: must not become an alpha search; alpha stays 0.002

tests.name: Stokes drift inclusion
tests.hypothesis: a wave-direction transport term reduces the orthogonal residual
tests.dependentVariable: M3, projection of added term onto the error vector
tests.risk: new term requires its own preregistration and calibration/holdout separation

tests.name: eddy-resolving forcing comparison (event-stratified)
tests.hypothesis: highest-error events correspond to mispositioned mesoscale structure
tests.risk: event stratification must be preregistered to avoid cherry-picking

tests.name: coastal / bathymetric sensitivity
tests.dependentVariable: n/a until a nearshore cohort exists
tests.risk: low priority; requires a new cohort rule
